name: Social media - micro post
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Social media - micro post.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Add and arrange your own content using the blocks below. Profile links open the original site. This section does not automatically import posts.

settings.label: Enable section
settings.how: Turn on “Enable section” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Kicker
settings.how: Enter the kicker. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: Recent highlights from X and Bluesky
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Body text
settings.how: Write the body text. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Layout style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Max columns on desktop
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust max columns on desktop. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Background style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for background style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Show platform badge (icon + label)
settings.how: Turn on “Show platform badge (icon + label)” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show handle
settings.how: Turn on “Show handle” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show timestamp text
settings.how: Turn on “Show timestamp text” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Open micro-post links in new tab
settings.how: Turn on “Open micro-post links in new tab” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: ARIA label for section
settings.default: Micro-post highlight strip from X and Bluesky
settings.how: Enter the aria label for section. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Platform
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for platform. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Display name
settings.how: Enter the display name. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Handle
settings.how: Enter the handle. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Post text
settings.how: Write the post text. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Timestamp / meta
settings.how: Enter the timestamp / meta. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Original post URL (optional)
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Link label
settings.how: Enter the link label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
